summary: scripts/st-test gains ST_TEST_POOL_RANK=last: a run whose ticket never ages and is never overdue, and which takes a pool tree only while no other run waits for one; the shadow queue signer's seed (scripts/evidence-queue-signer seed) now runs that way, so a seat's st-test never waits behind a seed of main's tip; docs/st3/gate-evidence.md also warns never to name a pool path in a command's arguments

replay.detail: No record, signature or storage format changes.

rules.detail: The pool order: a rank-999 ticket (ST_TEST_POOL_RANK=last) sorts after every other ticket however long it has waited, and its waiter skips the TREE_FREE_FALLBACK_SECONDS liveness path. Every other ticket's order is unchanged, and QUEUE_RULES is unchanged: no earlier copy writes a rank-999 ticket.

compatibility.detail: Callers that do not set ST_TEST_POOL_RANK are unchanged. An older st-test ignores the variable. Any other value fails the run before it takes a ticket.

downtime.detail: No restart: the seed timer reads the signer and st-test from main on its next tick.

recovery.detail: Revert the change; the seed queues at the host's default rank again.
